title: Event read-model decomposition
description: Objective: split the oversized event read model by decode, query, and materialization responsibility. Deliverable: focused internal modules with byte-budget, cursor, and snapshot semantics preserved. NOT in scope: schema changes, cursor redesign, or new query features. Hard dependencies: none. Owned paths: packages/store/src/event-read-model.ts, new event-read-*.ts, and event read-model tests. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: Public event read APIs and stable errors remain byte-for-byte compatible for existing fixtures.
Cursor, snapshot, maximum-record, and page-byte limits remain fail closed.
Every resulting production module is under 350 lines.
The focused store typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Refactor-only tasks preserve public contracts and stable errors.
Do not weaken or rewrite tests to make the split pass.
Stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.

implementationPlan.description: Add mutation-resistant characterization coverage before moving production code, without editing or weakening existing store tests. Through the public SqliteEventStore surface, seed a fixed command containing multiple ordered events and outbox messages and assert complete normalized values from getAggregateVersion, getCommandReceipt, readEvents/readAggregateEvents, readEventsAfter, readPendingOutbox/readPendingOutboxPage, including number-vs-bigint cursors, hasMore/nextCursor, effect/request digests, and byte contents. Pin exact DurableStoreError code+message pairs for negative/unsafe cursors, zero and 1,001 page limits, zero and 64-MiB-plus-one decoded-byte limits. Assert page/receipt envelopes and their arrays remain frozen, event/outbox objects and returned byte arrays remain mutable detached snapshots, and mutating one read cannot alter the next read. Keep this new table-driven test <=250 physical lines; existing hostile, byte-budget, WAL snapshot, core, recovery, decision, and project-binding tamper tests remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
implementationPlan.note: Added packages/store/src/event-read-model-contract.test.ts (249 physical lines, 23 tests, all passing). Characterizes the public SqliteEventStore read surface before the split: normalized getAggregateVersion/getCommandReceipt/readEvents/readAggregateEvents/readEventsAfter/readPendingOutbox/readPendingOutboxPage values incl. number vs bigint cursors, hasMore/nextCursor, request/effect digests, byte contents; empty tail pages; frozen page/receipt envelopes and arrays vs mutable detached event/outbox records and byte arrays; table-driven exact DurableStoreError code+message pins for identifier, negative/unsafe cursors, zero and 1001 limits, zero and 64MiB+1 decoded-byte budgets across all three page methods; both single-page overflow messages. No existing test files touched.

implementationPlan.description: Extract stored-row decoding into internal EventReadDecodeStore extending StoreRuntime. Move mapStoredEvent, mapOutboxMessage, page construction, and focused protected receipt/event/outbox row decoders so this layer owns only version/identifier/timestamp/integer/SHA/byte decoding and immutable snapshot construction, with no SQL queries or public read methods. Preserve the exact field evaluation order and messages, the decision-trace rule (all six scoped fields null means absent; any partial trace is STORE_CORRUPT), requireRowBytes detached-copy semantics, expected record/codec/request/effect versions, and the current shallow-freeze boundary. Add the required one-line `export * from "./event-read-decode.ts";` bridge and keep both files <=250 lines.
implementationPlan.note: Added event-read-decode.ts (238 lines) + event-read-decode.js bridge. EventReadDecodeStore extends StoreRuntime and owns only stored-row decoding and snapshot construction: page(), mapStoredEvent, mapOutboxMessage (now protected), plus focused protected decoders decodeReceiptRow / decodeReceiptEventIdentity / decodeReceiptEventBody / decodeReceiptOutboxIdentity / decodeReceiptOutboxBody. No SQL, no public read methods. Field evaluation order preserved exactly by sequential statements before each return literal; short-circuit comparison decodes (aggregate_id, request_sha256, committed_at, created_at) intentionally stay inline in loadReceipt so error precedence is unchanged. effectEventById.get moved after outbox identity decode - pure Map lookup, no observable change. EventReadModelStore now extends EventReadDecodeStore (534 lines, shrinks further in steps 3-5). pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck clean; 18 files / 112 tests pass.

implementationPlan.description: Extract receipt reconstruction into internal EventReadMaterializationStore extending EventReadDecodeStore. Move the exact RECEIPT_OUTBOX_QUERY bytes, loadReceipt, and validateAllReceipts here; delegate only row decoding to the prior layer. Preserve command-id lookup, project-scope lookup and PROJECT_SCOPE_REQUIRED precedence, optional live-binding and aggregate-tail flags, request/result/effect version checks, receipt/event/outbox count and ordering checks, event-to-outbox association, effect digest recomputation, aggregate-tail validation, command_id startup order, disappearance handling, and every stable STORE_CORRUPT message. Do not add a read snapshot or change query order: getCommandReceipt must retain its current readOperation semantics. Re-export the SQL constant later through event-read-model.ts, add the one-line .js bridge, and keep both files <=250 lines.
implementationPlan.note: Added event-read-materialization.ts (249 lines) + .js bridge. EventReadMaterializationStore extends EventReadDecodeStore and owns RECEIPT_OUTBOX_QUERY (byte-identical, still EXPLAIN-QUERY-PLAN asserted by sqlite-event-store-core.test.ts), loadReceipt, validateAllReceipts. All precedence preserved: command-id key check, scope lookup then PROJECT_SCOPE_REQUIRED, optional live-binding/aggregate-tail flags, version/count/order checks, event-to-outbox association, effect digest recomputation, startup command_id ordering and disappearance handling, every STORE_CORRUPT message. getCommandReceipt still runs under readOperation - no snapshot added. Only whitespace-level change: the three internal (non-exported) SQL literals for command_receipts, command_receipt_scopes, and domain_events were hoisted to module constants with denser column lists so the module fits the 250-line rail; predicates, order, and parameters are identical. event-read-model.ts now extends EventReadMaterializationStore and re-exports RECEIPT_OUTBOX_QUERY (274 lines, facade work lands in steps 4-5). typecheck clean; 18 files / 112 tests pass.

implementationPlan.description: Extract bounded event/outbox page querying into internal EventReadQueryStore extending EventReadMaterializationStore. Implement protected aggregate, global, and pending-outbox page operations with the existing input defaults and validation order (cached project binding before request fields), exact SQL predicates/order, `limit + 1` preflight, decoded-byte prefix selection, selected-last-cursor materialization, assertReadPageCursors, and frozen page construction. Keep each candidate-size query and its materialization query inside the same readSnapshotOperation/BEGIN DEFERRED so concurrent WAL writes cannot split the snapshot; never decode a later excluded/corrupt row. Preserve aggregate cursors as number and global/outbox cursors as bigint, empty pages as `{items:[], hasMore:false, nextCursor:null}`, and MAX_PAGE_SIZE/MAX_PAGE_DECODED_BYTES fail-closed behavior. Add the one-line .js bridge and keep both files <=250 lines.
implementationPlan.note: Added event-read-query.ts (229 lines) + .js bridge. EventReadQueryStore extends EventReadMaterializationStore with protected aggregateEventPage / globalEventPage / pendingOutboxPage. Bodies moved verbatim: same defaults (0/0n, 100, MAX_PAGE_DECODED_BYTES), same validation order (assertCachedProjectBinding, identifier, cursor, limit, byte budget), same SQL predicates/order, limit+1 preflight, selectReadPagePrefix, selected-last-cursor materialization, assertReadPageCursors, frozen this.page construction. Each preflight and its materialization stay inside one readSnapshotOperation with the unchanged labels "read aggregate events" / "read global events" / "read pending outbox", so BEGIN DEFERRED still covers both and later excluded rows are never decoded. Aggregate cursors stay number, global/outbox stay bigint, empty pages stay {items:[],hasMore:false,nextCursor:null}. typecheck clean; 18 files / 112 tests pass.

implementationPlan.description: Reduce event-read-model.ts to the compatibility facade `EventReadModelStore extends EventReadQueryStore`. Keep every existing public method name, signature, default, return type, readOperation/readSnapshotOperation label, and single-page overflow message; public page methods delegate to the protected query layer, while getAggregateVersion/getCommandReceipt/readEvents/readPendingOutbox retain their exact wrapping and freeze behavior. Preserve protected loadReceipt/validateAllReceipts through inheritance for EventLedgerStore, and re-export RECEIPT_OUTBOX_QUERY with byte-identical SQL so sqlite-event-store.ts and query-plan tests require no changes. Do not change event-read-model.js, event-ledger.ts, package-root exports, schemas, cursors, or query features. Keep the facade <=250 lines.
implementationPlan.note: event-read-model.ts is now a 93-line compatibility facade: EventReadModelStore extends EventReadQueryStore. All seven public methods keep their names, signatures, defaults and return types. getAggregateVersion/getCommandReceipt keep their readOperation labels and freeze behavior; readEvents/readPendingOutbox keep their exact single-page overflow messages; readAggregateEvents/readEventsAfter/readPendingOutboxPage delegate to the protected query layer, which owns the unchanged readSnapshotOperation labels. loadReceipt/validateAllReceipts remain protected and reach EventLedgerStore through inheritance. RECEIPT_OUTBOX_QUERY is re-exported from event-read-materialization.js with byte-identical SQL, so event-ledger.ts, sqlite-event-store.ts, event-read-model.js, index.ts, and the EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN test are untouched. typecheck clean; 18 files / 112 tests pass.

implementationPlan.description: Adversarially review the owned diff as a behavior-preserving move, not a redesign. Compare each old method block against its new layer and attack empty pages, exact and one-byte-short budgets, single-record-over-ceiling corruption, limit 1/1,000/1,001, number/bigint max boundaries, future record versions, partial decision traces, receipt scope/tail/count/order/digest tampering, concurrent WAL writes between preflight and blob reads, caller mutation of returned bytes, closed/busy/rollback normalization, and subclass startup validation. Confirm stable codes/messages, SQL/order, snapshot transaction boundaries, cursor advancement, frozen-vs-mutable boundaries, and public exports are unchanged. Run a cross-platform Node line-count assertion over event-read-model.ts, the three new production .ts modules, all three bridges, and event-read-model-contract.test.ts and fail if any exceeds 250 physical lines. Inspect `git diff --` for exactly these eight owned paths and no scratch/generated evidence; if review changes bytes, rerun the affected focused test before the final gate.
implementationPlan.note: Adversarial review done. Mechanical proof: a Node block-extractor compared each old method body in HEAD:event-read-model.ts against its new layer - page, mapStoredEvent, mapOutboxMessage, getAggregateVersion, getCommandReceipt, readEvents, readPendingOutbox, validateAllReceipts, and all three page queries are byte-identical modulo the signature line. A normalized diff of loadReceipt shows only the five intended extraction hunks. RECEIPT_OUTBOX_QUERY string-compares equal to HEAD (497 chars). Findings and dispositions: (1) key insertion order changed in two INTERNAL draft literals (effectEvent, outbox push) because the decoder spread now precedes outbox:[] - verified non-observable, identifyCommandEffects hashes named fields only and neither draft is returned to a caller; (2) mapStoredEvent/mapOutboxMessage widened private->protected, required by the split, and none of the four classes is exported from index.ts so the public surface is unchanged; (3) three non-exported SQL literals reformatted (whitespace only, same predicates/params/order) - only RECEIPT_OUTBOX_QUERY is EXPLAIN-QUERY-PLAN asserted and it is byte-identical; (4) effectEventById.get now runs after the outbox identity decode instead of between two decodes - Map.get cannot throw, so error precedence is unchanged; (5) short-circuit comparison decodes (aggregate_id, request_sha256, committed_at, created_at) deliberately stay inline in loadReceipt so a corrupt SHA behind a mismatched aggregate_id still reports the original "does not match receipt" message. planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Keeping page queries in the 664-line class or combining decode and receipt reconstruction was rejected because both preserve the oversized mixed-responsibility design. The selected internal inheritance chain is EventReadDecodeStore -> EventReadMaterializationStore -> EventReadQueryStore -> EventReadModelStore. This retains protected StoreRuntime access and the EventLedgerStore subclass contract without widening public exports. Three one-line .js bridges are required by the repository's NodeNext/raw strip-types convention; they account for the path count but not additional logic.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: EventReadModelStore currently owns seven public read methods plus protected loadReceipt/validateAllReceipts. Aggregate/global/outbox pages first select `limit + 1` cursor/decoded-byte candidates, use selectReadPagePrefix, then materialize only the selected cursor range inside one readSnapshotOperation/BEGIN DEFERRED. Page envelopes and item arrays are frozen, receipt envelopes and ID arrays are frozen, but StoredEvent/PendingOutboxMessage objects and detached Uint8Array copies remain mutable. EventLedgerStore consumes protected loadReceipt, validateAllReceipts, and the exact RECEIPT_OUTBOX_QUERY export. MAX_PAGE_SIZE is 1,000 and MAX_PAGE_DECODED_BYTES is 64 MiB.
planningNotes.risks: Moving methods across classes can silently change protected visibility, validation/error precedence, snapshot transaction scope, cursor type/order, when corrupt later rows are decoded, or byte-copy/freeze behavior. Preserve every SQL predicate/order/limit, default argument, stable DurableStoreError code/message, field read order, and the no-extra-public-export boundary. Per the user's strengthened rail, every changed/new production or test source must be <=250 physical lines even though the task DoD only requires <350.
